description: The default capability for the replayed review window: the core Tauri APIs plus the open-file dialog the settings panel's folder picker uses (open only — it returns a path and grants nothing else), and the updater's check and download-and-install commands, which the settings panel's "Check for updates" button calls and nothing else does. There is no filesystem, shell or http permission here — clip files reach the webview through the asset protocol, whose scope is configured in tauri.conf.json and extended at runtime in src/lib.rs to the resolved clips directory. The updater's two permissions are the whole of the internet this application can reach: they ask one fixed GitHub URL for the release manifest, and every artifact they download is verified against the minisign public key pinned in tauri.conf.json before it is installed.
